patch_description: This crossover keeps the reliable LP radius polish and safety repair from both predecessors, while combining squared-distance and physical-distance SLSQP formulations in a two-stage continuation. It adds staggered hexagonal/layered seeds alongside the prior square-grid seeds, since 26 circles benefit from broken symmetry and boundary-adapted rows. Constraint Jacobians are vectorized to reduce optimizer overhead. Each stage and original seed is retained as a candidate, ensuring an interrupted or locally unfavorable refinement cannot replace a stronger packing.
